backend/main.mo: Defines chat sessions and messages with functions to start a session, send messages, and retrieve session messages using List-based storage.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence mappings connecting features to relevant files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides prewritten one-line summaries for key frontend files to support build planning.
frontend/index.css: Implements Tailwind base layers and OKLCH design tokens for light and dark themes across the app.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router routes and wraps the app with ThemeProvider and AppLayout.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Provides the site-wide layout with header navigation, mobile menu, and footer.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity with React Query caching and invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useChatApi.ts: React Query hooks for fetching chat history and sending messages via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useChatSession.ts: Initializes and persists a chat session ID in localStorage and syncs it with the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and status handling.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom CSS variables for light and dark theme color palettes.
frontend/src/lib/demoBot.ts: Implements a simple demo chatbot that generates canned or contextual replies based on user message content.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and the Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the About page with mission, features, technology details, and project background for KairoNova.
frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.tsx: Implements the chat UI, handling message input, history loading, bot replies, and send interactions.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Displays the landing page with a hero section, feature highlights, and navigation to chat or learn more.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyDisclaimerPage: React page that sets the document title and displays KairoNova’s privacy, disclaimer, and acceptable‑use information using cards and alerts.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining content paths, theme extensions, custom colors, fonts, shadows, and plugin usage.
project_state.json: Project metadata and requirements describing the KairoNova website’s features, branding goals, pages, and pending backend tasks.
